Get Lucky × Indwe Risk Services — a compact, forward-looking view of what we've built, what we've learned, and where the partnership goes next.

January – August 2026
In short

We missed the conversion targets. We built something far bigger.

Eight months in, the original hole-in-one conversion model has not delivered the new business we projected. We are not going to dress that up.

What we have built together is a national platform, a fully automated golfer-to-golfer pipeline, and a set of partnerships that turn this from a South African sponsorship into a scalable global product.

Missed
The Year-1 hole-in-one funnel has not converted at the rate we modelled. The leads are real; the switch trigger was not.
Built
A national platform, an automated WhatsApp pipeline, and the world's first hole-in-1 app — engineered end to end.
Next
Ernie Els, Icons Cup SA and the PGA Show — plus a route to international insurance partners that changes the economics entirely.

03 · The biggest update

The world's first hole-in-1 app.

One paid shot at a hole-in-one on every par 3, anywhere we are live — armed on the tee, filmed, verified, and paid by the insurer. A product that travels, rather than a sponsorship fixed to 30 par 3s.

Live at SA's Top 100 courses — beta 46,000 courses worldwide 47.2m golfers in target markets $10/month, one insured swing
01

Armed

The insured hole is armed on the tee: GPS inside the 7th, a registered ball, tee cam locked. Nothing counts until all three check out.

02

Filmed

Every swing on the hole is recorded, in order, with the group watching. This is what makes an ace verifiable rather than a claim someone has to take on trust.

03

Paid

A verified ace opens the claim automatically. The prize is paid by the insurer — never out of another golfer's pocket.

07 · What we’ve learned

The leads are real. The conversion model was wrong.

01The lead was never the problem. We put 1,010 affluent golfer leads in front of Indwe. The audience is right, and it is reachable.
02But these golfers are already insured. They are wealthy, they have cover, and almost all of them already have a broker they have used for years.
03A free swing wins attention, not a policy. Nobody moves a decade-old insurance relationship because they enjoyed a competition on the tee. It takes a golfer-to-golfer conversation and a real reason to ask for a quote.
★ So we changed what we were building

We stopped chasing lead volume and started building assets.

Pushing more leads through the same funnel was not going to fix a positioning problem. The last four months went into the things that keep working after the swing: an automated WhatsApp pipeline, a growing member base, the app, and the partnerships.

That is what the rest of this deck is about.

08 · Why the partnership makes strategic sense

Eight months into a long game. Now is not the time to pivot.

We all agreed this was a long-term play for South Africa’s affluent golfers. What we are doing now is learning how to position Indwe as the go-to broker for golfers, and for the golf industry as a whole.

01We agreed on a long game. Eight months is where that strategy gets tested, not abandoned — and affluent leads are real and flowing.
02Get Lucky has evolved. From headline sponsorship into a hands-on sales agency for golfers — front and centre in two of Indwe’s strategic initiatives: affluent leads and partnerships.
03The model compounds. A recurring membership relationship, national broadcast, the app and 150,000 golfers means reach that grows season on season.
04It now reaches past the fairway. The app and founding-partner alliances take Indwe’s association with golf from 30+ par 3s into every player’s pocket — locally, then internationally.
05A phased, honest route to returns. Year-1 new business has not landed as modelled — but the database, the app and the partner network compound, and the international route changes the economics entirely.
★ Our MissionNot just hole-in-1s — let’s own golf. Indwe becomes the go-to broker for South African golfers, and for the golf industry as a whole.

09 · The proposal

Help us go global — and South Africa runs at no cost.

01Where we are. The Year-1 hole-in-one conversion model has not delivered the new business we projected. We own that, and we are not asking anyone to pretend otherwise.
02What we built instead. A national platform, an automated pipeline, the world's first hole-in-1 app, and founding partnerships with Ernie Els and Icons Cup SA. Together we have built a global product, not a local sponsorship.
03What we are asking for. Introductions to international insurance partners. Indwe's credibility and network in this industry open doors that ours cannot.
04What Indwe gets. Continued exclusive access to South Africa's most affluent golfers — the brand, the database, the app and the pipeline — with the cost taken off the table, alongside the modelled R28.8m brokerage line as the app scales internationally.
★ The OfferIf Indwe helps us sign sponsorship deals with international insurance partners, we will continue the South African partnership at no cost to Indwe.
